rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for an ordinary secretary or clerical assistant.

example.english: My secretary helped me sort out some documents today.
example.traditional: 我個秘書今日幫我整理啲文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 bei3 syu1 gam1 jat6 bong1 ngo5 zing2 lei5 di1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this mainly for a record-keeping or clerical secretary in a formal organizational context, not as the everyday default.

example.english: The secretary is responsible for recording the contents of the meeting.
example.traditional: 書記負責記錄會議內容。
example.jyutping: syu1 gei3 fu6 zaak3 gei3 luk6 wui2 ji5 noi6 jung4

rows.note: Use this for the head of a government bureau or department, rather than for a clerical secretary.

example.english: The secretary went to the Legislative Council for a meeting today.
example.traditional: 局長今日去立法會開會。
example.jyutping: guk6 zoeng2 gam1 jat6 heoi3 lap6 faat3 wui2 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this for a secretary-general or a senior secretary title in a government or organization.

example.english: The secretary gave a speech at the party congress.
example.traditional: 秘書長喺黨大會上致辭。
example.jyutping: bei3 syu1 zoeng2 hai2 dong2 daai6 wui2 soeng6 zi3 ci4
